messages:
elaine_marketing: Quick sync — HelixWave case study. Need final customer quote approval and legal greenlight on embedded excerpts. Target launch: Tue 03/28. Can legal + customer ops sign off by EOD Mon? :clock3:

jake_content: Uploaded raw interview clips here: drive/link/helixwave (placeholder) — clip list below:
```
1) 00:00-00:30 - HelixWave on latency gains
2) 00:31-01:10 - Quote: "Redwood cut our inference cost by 60%"
3) 01:11-01:40 - Customer story: rollout timeline
```
Which ones do we need quoted text approval for? :thinking:

tom_prodops: We should prioritize clip 1 + 2 for the launch post and webinar snippet. Clip 2 contains the exact percent — legal will need to verify marketing claim.

sarah_legal: Copying legal checklist: need written permission for any direct claims and the full quote redline. Also need to confirm HelixWave is okay with the exact % metric. I'll draft a short release agreement. ETA: EOD today.

casey_se: For inbound lead routing — recommend tagging HelixWave in CRM as "case-study" and route Tier-A demo requests to the SEs on the account team (cc @jake_content for content follow-ups).

jake_content: Updated draft quote with bracketed metric: "Redwood cut our inference cost by [60%]" — will hand to customer for exact number.

elaine_marketing: @sarah_legal thanks. Once you post the release agreement in this thread I'll ping the HelixWave PM. Also need a 30s edited clip and 3 social captions. @tom_prodops can you confirm availability for webinar snippet edit by tomorrow?

tom_prodops: Confirmed — I'll drop the edited 30s clip in Drive by 12pm UTC tomorrow. Adding notes: remove customer's internal tool names and any sensitive ops details.

sarah_legal: Draft release share: 
```
Please confirm the following for public use:
- Approval of verbatim quote
- Approval of 30s clip
- Permission to use HelixWave logo and metrics
- Any embargo date constraints
```
Sending to HelixWave PM now. I'll post updates here.

release-bot: Calendar invite created: Case Study Launch — Tue 03/28 10:00 PT (includes marketing, legal, SE). Invite link: calendar.example/abc

elaine_marketing: Great — if HelixWave approves metric by EOD Mon we can lock webinar promo + blog. Otherwise we'll go with the bracketed claim and avoid the %.

casey_se: Also flagged for SDR playbook: use the case study as mid-funnel asset for demo conversions. Will prepare routing doc once quote is approved.

sarah_legal: HelixWave PM replied: approves quote BUT requests changing "60%" to "approximately 60%" and wants 48h review prior to publish. They also requested to see the final social captions.

elaine_marketing: Cool — we'll switch to "~60%" in the quote and send captions. @jake_content can you update copy and push the social variants? I'll draft the final caption options.

jake_content: Done — pushed caption options to Drive and tagged for legal review. Shortlist: 
- "HelixWave slashed inference costs by ~60% with Redwood Inference. Read their story."
- "How HelixWave cut inference costs and scaled reliably — case study out Tue."

elaine_marketing: Thanks team. Next steps: Sarah finalize legal signoff doc; Jake finalize assets; Tom drop clip; Casey prep routing doc. Aim: Monday EOD approvals -> Tuesday publish. :rocket:

sarah_legal: Will send signoff PDF by 17:00 PT today.

elaine_marketing: perfect, closing loop.
